info.title: devprojex
info.description: Turn a folder or repository into focused context for AI from the CLI, TUI, or MCP server.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path, or - for stdout. Default: -.

options.name: --force
options.description: Atomically replace an existing context file.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Return exit code 3 when diagnostics exist.

options.name: --findings
options.description:
Include sanitized effective redaction findings.
Enables secret detection automatically.

options.name: --fail-on-findings
options.description: Return exit code 3 when effective findings exist.

options.name: --top-files
options.description:
List the N largest selected text files by
estimated tokens.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Repository branch for a URL source.

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Selection profile: standard, local, or a portable profile file. Default:
standard.

options.name: --select
options.description: Include a relative file or directory path. Repeatable.

options.name: --select-from
options.description:
Read source-relative selected paths from a UTF-8
file or stdin (-).

options.name: --git-mode
options.description:
Git filtering mode: none, gitignore, tracked,
staged, changes, or diff:<ref>..<ref>.

options.name: --max-file-bytes
options.description:
Exclude selected files larger than SIZE (bytes or
IEC suffixes).

options.name: --hide-secrets
options.description:
Redact detected values in selected text files.
Binary files are not inspected; no matches is not
a safety guarantee.

options.name: --hide-private-data
options.description:
Redact detected private data in selected text files. Binary files are not
inspected; no matches is not a privacy guarantee.

options.name: --compress-code
options.description:
Compress supported source files to signatures.
Bodies of functions and methods are replaced with
a placeholder; anything unsupported is left in
full.

options.name: --strip-comments
options.description:
Source files are never modified; unsupported or
rejected files are left in full.

options.name: --strip-blank-lines
options.description:
Remove blank lines from supported source files. Source files are never
modified; unsupported or rejected files are left in full.

options.name: --progress
options.description:
Progress mode. Default: auto.
-?, -h, /?, /h, --help      Show help and usage information.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the local read-only MCP stdio server.

options.name: --root
options.description: Allow an MCP project root. Repeatable.

options.name: --hide-private-data
options.description:
Redact detected private data in selected text
files. Binary files are not inspected; no matches
is not a privacy guarantee.

options.name: --allow-remote
options.description:
Allow MCP tools to clone and inspect remote Git
repository URLs.

options.name: --live
options.description:
Use the DevProjex window selection as the live
baseline.

options.name: --remote-hosts
options.description:
Allow only these comma-separated remote Git hosts when --allow-remote is
enabled. Repeatable.

options.name: --git-mode
options.description: Baseline Git filtering mode: none, gitignore, or tracked.

options.name: --tool-set
options.description:
Publish the full tool catalog, or reduced without
analyze and pack_context. Default: full.

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Baseline exclusion set for the server: exclusion
names, default, or none. Names replace the default
set; list default to extend it. Repeatable.

options.name: --unrestricted
options.description:
Show everything: turn every exclusion off and
disable Git filtering. Secret redaction stays on.

options.name: --allow-agent-exclusions
options.description:
Let the agent set the exclusion toggles per call
(adds an exclusions parameter to selection tools).
-?, -h, /?, /h, --help      Show help and usage information.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Connect an MCP client to a project.

options.name: --client
options.description:
Choose claude-code, codex, cursor, vscode, or
json. Default: claude-code.

options.name: --mode
options.description:
Choose live window selection or standard server
behavior. Default: standard.

options.name: --print
options.description:
Print configuration without changing client or
project settings.

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the client after connecting it.

options.name: --replace
options.description:
Confirm replacing an existing devprojex entry:
extra fields in a Cursor or VS Code entry, or the
single Codex entry when it points to another
project.
-?, -h, /?, /h, --help      Show help and usage information.

directory.
